items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, especially if you walk for 10 to 19 minutes. If you take certain medications, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, so try to start dinner before 8 pm. Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: A longer overnight fast may be helpful, as adding it to coaching changed some numbers, but it's not clear yet. Your overnight fast averaged 10.0 hours, and it might be good to try for more hours.
